texts.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行的地表探险发现了这一改造的外勤站以及它唯一的居住者。

她自称是一名被困多年的科学家，在这片恶劣的星球里孤身生存至今，如今愿以她的专业知识换取[root.Owner.GetName]的救援。
texts.en:
A surface expedition to [from.GetName] located the repurposed field station and its lone occupant.

Identifying herself as a stranded scientist who has endured this harsh world for years, she offers her expertise to the [root.Owner.GetName] in exchange for rescue.

label.zh: 她的经验可是无价之宝。
给她一艘飞船和一些物资。
label.en: Gift her a shuttle and supplies.

label.zh: 真有趣。摧毁她的庇护所。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

texts.zh:
一位形容枯槁的[scru_species.GetClass]走出她改装为居所的外勤站。当她谈及自己在[from.From.GetName]上的遭遇时，从她[scru_species.GetMouthName]中发出的声音沙哑破碎；言语断断续续。

“请原谅……我已经很多年……没有和人说过话了……”
texts.en:
An emaciated [scru_species.GetClass] steps out of her hab-converted field station. When she speaks of her ordeal on [from.From.GetName], the sounds from her [scru_species.GetMouthName] rasps; words arrive in fits and starts.

"Forgive me. I have not... spoken to another in many years..."

label.zh: 你为什么落难到这里了？

responses.zh: 我当时正在勘测[from.From.GetName]，记录基岩的独特特征。我的船员说他们要驾驶探测飞船简单检查一下。我信了他们。焦虑了几天后，我才意识到，他们直接开回家了。
responses.en: I was surveying [from.From.GetName], cataloging the unique bedrock. My crew said they'd do a quick sweep in our exploration craft. I believed them. Only after a few days of worrying did I realize what had happened. They took off and flew home.

label.en: How did you survive here for so long?

responses.zh: 哦，真是奇妙啊。只要稍微改造细胞通透性，再让热休克蛋白过度表达……之后，要在我改造的细胞上诱导大自噬就简单得多了。而多亏了这个世界丰富的钠含量，我得以烹制出许多美味佳肴。
responses.en: Oh it's a wonder what you can do when modifying cell permeability and hyper-expressing heat shock proteins... After that, it was simple to induce macroautophagy on my modified cells, and thanks to the sodium content of this world I could generate many savory meals.

label.zh: 你还想和同类们重见吗？
label.en: Do you not want to rejoin your own kind?

responses.zh: 他们不配拥有我在这块岩石上取得的突破。我根本不想知道他们抛弃我的神经借口。
responses.en: They don't deserve the breakthroughs I've made on this rock. I don't care to learn what duplicitous reasons they had for abandoning me.

label.en: What can you do for us?

responses.zh: 我已经厌倦在简陋的实验室工作。我渴望从太空去看新世界。
responses.en: I'm tired of working in a makeshift lab. I want to see new worlds... From space.

tooltips.en: Scru joins our empire as a Leader.

summary.text:
# 改造的外勤站 / Repurposed Field Station

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:626; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1679 (extreme_frontiers.350); events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1758 (extreme_frontiers.352)

## 如何开始 How it starts

荒芜或寒冷荒芜星球可能生成（8级，权重3，全局一次 max_once_global；需要 has_shroud_dlc，且尚未存在 survivalist_scru 事件目标）。

Can spawn on a barren or cold barren planet (level 8, weight 3, once globally via max_once_global; needs has_shroud_dlc and no existing survivalist_scru target).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.350“孤独幸存者”：a（非杀戮帝国）把幸存者带来见面，进入 extreme_frontiers.352“斯科露”招募窗口（随机生成一名与你主物种不同类别的幸存者领袖；可对话后招募，或遣散获得每月社会研究）；b（非杀戮，需15合金与15食物）消耗这些资源换取每月团结；c（非杀戮）每月社会研究；d（仅杀戮帝国）每月团结。

Single result extreme_frontiers.350 "Lone Survivor": a (non-homicidal) brings the survivor over into extreme_frontiers.352 "Scru", a recruitment window (a survivor leader of a randomly drawn species class different from your main species; talk, then recruit, or dismiss for monthly society research); b (non-homicidal, costs 15 alloys and 15 food) trades them for monthly unity; c (non-homicidal) monthly society research; d (homicidal only) monthly unity.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

350 的四个选项互不相同，只有选项a通向 352。352 的对话选项只展示回答，最后在招募与遣散间二选一。

350's four options are alternatives and only a leads to 352. In 352 the dialogue options only show replies; the final choice is recruit or dismiss.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

选项按杀戮帝国状态与库存限制。

Options depend on homicidal status and stockpiles.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义、项目与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition, the project and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
